title: Marinated Olives with Toasted Almonds
summary: A simple Spanish-style tapas snack of briny olives and crunchy toasted almonds, brightened with lemon, garlic and parsley. Best served at room temperature with a drink before dinner.
steps: Tip the almonds into a dry frying pan and toast over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes, shaking often, until golden and fragrant. Transfer to a bowl to cool slightly.
In a mixing bowl, combine the olives, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, parsley, paprika, salt and black pepper. Stir well so the olives are evenly coated.
Add the warm toasted almonds and toss again.
Leave to marinate for 5 minutes, then serve at room temperature.
If you like, spoon the olives and almonds into a small dish and drizzle over any remaining dressing before serving.
